g.text: UML - native periodic basis capture, replay and audit recovery
Account + exact published policy + period start
Current maker / REVIEW; capture original scope
Recheck live canonical person / grants / queue after wait
Original artifact / clock / native source membership
Exact policy product binding and finite UTC calendar
One statement MVCC snapshot of account metadata
and committed native business-date journal prefix
Atomic immutable native artifact + source digests
Read saved artifact + exact saved native journal facts
Verify raw/typed hashes, metadata, scope and totals
Preview using saved native clock and basis
Suppress ineligible basis; no financial command
Saved URL; separate current vs historical position
Open provisional / closed observation; paged native sources
Next 50 basis UUIDs after persisted cursor
Advance past failures; wrap for retry
No enrollment, financial posting, hold mutation or amount owed.
Closed period is not a global book close; late facts need a fresh key.
Replay never refreshes a saved observation.
